evidence: Er-doped Y2O3 thin films were deposited on p-type Si(100) substrates by a radical-enhanced ALD process, as previously reported elsewhere. 11 In this study, Tris(2,2,6,6-tetramethyl-3,5-heptanedionato)yttrium(III), or Y(TMHD)3, and Tris(2,2,6,6-tetramethyl-3,5-heptanedionato)erbium(III), or Er(TMHD)3, were chosen as the metal precursors and O radicals as the oxidizing agent.
